The MINIMUM is taken rather than the /// first one walked: several functions are scanned and their instruction order is the lowering's, /// not the source's, while php reports the earliest mention in the file. fn first_mention_line(module: &crate::ir::Module, name: &str) -> u32 { let Some(data_id) = module .data .global_names .iter() .position(|candidate| candidate.trim_start_matches('\\') == name) else { return 0; }; let mut earliest = 0u32; let groups = [ &module.functions, &module.class_methods, &module.closures, ]; for group in groups { for function in group.iter() { for inst in &function.instructions { if !matches!(inst.immediate, Some(Immediate::GlobalName(id)) if id.as_raw() as usize == data_id) { continue; } let Some(span) = inst.span else { continue }; if span.line != 0 && (earliest == 0 || span.line < earliest) { earliest = span.line; } } } } earliest
